features.feature_value: Long enumerative list of policy domains (benefits + regulation)
features.evidence_span: "Voting Rights, universal healthcare, unions, labor laws, pensions, gun laws, subsidized renewable, fully funded education, subsidized childcare"
features.rationale: A comma-separated sequence of multiple policy items signals an organized platform-style framing.

features.feature_value: Blame cast as intentional theft by “politicians” portrayed with extreme moral/psychological insult
features.evidence_span: "we've been robbed of every day by politicians purchased by psychopaths"
features.rationale: Uses strong moral/emotive language and a causal blame attribution to a named actor class.

features.feature_value: Question framed as accusing others of harming through fossil-fuel allegiance; includes pejorative metaphor
features.evidence_span: "slobbery fealty to the fossil fuels industry"
features.rationale: Contains normative accusation and abusive figurative language toward a target stance.

features.feature_value: Interrogative that implies an intent to alleviate suffering and contrasts priorities
features.evidence_span: "Excuse me, are you trying to do something to alleviate the suffering"
features.rationale: The post uses a direct question to prompt/press for a policy change while implicitly assigning responsibility.

features.feature_value: Repetitive pattern: “When X didn’t work, you make MORE X; those also don’t work”
features.evidence_span: "When previous gun laws didn't work.  You make MORE gun laws.  Those also don't work."
features.rationale: Shows an explicit cause→failure→intensification sequence repeated across paragraphs.

features.feature_value: Claim that criminals/“crazies”/terrorists do not obey laws
features.evidence_span: "Criminals crazies and terrorists don't obey the law."
features.rationale: A factual-assertive justification linking lawmaking to enforcement limits.

features.feature_value: Uses “teach able moment” to argue that labeling weapons is beside the point; explicitly corrects scope
features.evidence_span: "It is a teachable moment that you think it matters"
features.rationale: Meta-discursive framing evaluates what “matters” and redirects the argument.

features.feature_value: Solicits money with specific amount to influence election/persuasion
features.rationale: Contains a direct fundraising call-to-action and uses an identifier-like comparison of “me” vs “my opponent”.
